title: Marathon to Key West Private Tour of Florida Keys
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Visit the one-and-only island city of KEY WEST!

Enjoy a narrated tour on the way down, and island music on the way back.

HIGHLIGHTS
 • See the sights in Key West 
 • Stay for the Key West sunset 
 • Plenty of Free Time 
 • Designated Driver 
 • Narrated Tour 

Do what you want in Key West! We're doing the driving! 

Sightsee, enjoy a happy hour, eat a nice dinner, check out Mallory Square at sunset, take a sunset sail, and more!

Sit back & enjoy the scenery as we drive down to Key West. Learn the history, culture, and ecology of the Florida Keys & Key West from your friendly local guide.

See the Southernmost Point, Hemingway's House, Mile Marker Zero, Sloppy Joe's, and Mallory Square

It's more like a road trip than a tour - ask questions, point out wildlife, make new friends.
